headline: Containing Distress Before Capital Breaches Parity

blocks.text: 01 / Volatility Spike: Health factor compresses under unattended adverse price movement.
02 / 1.1x Boundary: Autonomous risk policies activate before collateral reaches parity.
03 / Floor Division: mul_wad_down executes to prevent rounding in the protocol's favour.
04 / Isolated Settlement: Distress is fully resolved without cross-margin contagion.

focal.reason: Floor division is the core mathematical guarantee preventing bias during liquidation.
